thread.title: Apple's stock heads for biggest-ever 5-day price gain; adds nearly 150 points to a flat Dow this week

author: morningstar.com
title: Apple's stock heads for biggest-ever 5-day price gain; adds nearly 150 points to a flat Dow this week
text:
With Apple Inc.'s stock (AAPL) surging 3.8% toward a record close Friday, and headed for the biggest weekly gain in 6 1/2 years, the stock is also on track to post the biggest five-day price gain in its history. The stock is up 13.1% so far this week, the biggest five-day percentage gain since the 14.1% jump during the five days ending Oct. 14, 2011, after the company reported better-than-expected earnings (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/apple-stock-rises-after-iphone-sales-fall-short-but-earnings-beat-2018-05-01) and Warren Buffett said he boosted his stake (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/warren-buffetts-berkshire-hathaway-bought-75-million-apple-shares-in-first-quarter-2018-05-03) in the company. The $21.28 price gain this week is the biggest (split adjusted) for a five-day stretch since the stock started trading in December 1980. The price gain added about 147 points to the Dow Jones Industrial Average's price; the Dow is up 381 points Friday but is about flat on the week.
-Tomi Kilgore; 1444ET
